_about: Ingredient vocabulary for IFCT 2017, UK CoFID and USDA foods, read by tools/build_foods.py. 'foods' is keyed by app id (ifct-<code>, cofid-<UK code>, usda-<US code>) and sets the display name, search aliases (Hindi and regional names), tier (A everyday … D obscure), units (grams per tsp, tbsp, cup, katori, piece, serving), liquid and serving label. Foods not listed keep their cleaned source name, category defaults and tier C. 'drop' lists rows left out because the same ingredient is already in IFCT 2017 (IFCT is kept). 'noEnergy' says what was done with UK rows that have no energy value. 'synonyms' are extra word groups for search.

drop.UK-14-001: Amla: same as IFCT E021 Gooseberry (Emblica officinalis)
drop.UK-14-347: Bananas: IFCT E009–E012 has bananas (and this row is weighed with skin)
drop.UK-14-844: Sesame seeds: IFCT H009–H011 Gingelly seeds
drop.UK-13-622: Sweetcorn kernels: IFCT A008 Maize, tender, sweet
drop.UK-13-064: Broad beans: IFCT D032 Broad beans (Vicia faba)
drop.UK-14-820: 'Coconut milk' in CoFID is the liquid inside the nut (22 kcal, 0.3 g fat), not cooking coconut milk: same as IFCT K002 Coconut water
drop.UK-13-342: Shallots: IFCT G018 Onion, small (sambar onion) is the Indian shallot
drop.UK-14-263: Sultanas: IFCT E058 Raisins, dried, golden
drop.US-173756: Chickpeas, mature seeds: IFCT B002 Bengal gram, whole
drop.US-174270: Soybeans, mature seeds: IFCT B024/B025 Soybean
drop.US-170174: Coconut water: IFCT K002 Coconut water

noEnergy.UK-13-873: Chilli powder: not imported. Searching "chilli powder" or "lal mirch" finds IFCT G022 Chillies, red (dried red chilli; measured Indian values).
noEnergy.UK-13-886: Mixed curry spices: not imported. UK CoFID Curry powder and Garam masala (both with energy values) cover it.
noEnergy.UK-17-726: Stock cubes, chicken: not imported. Values depend on the brand; add the packet as a "From packet label" food.
noEnergy.UK-17-727: Stock cubes, vegetable: not imported. Values depend on the brand; add the packet as a "From packet label" food.
noEnergy.UK-13-874: Cinnamon: added as an Estimate food (id cinnamon-ground), protein/fat/fibre from CoFID, carbohydrate estimated.
noEnergy.UK-13-827: Fennel seeds: added as an Estimate food (id fennel-seeds), protein/fat from CoFID, carbohydrate and fibre estimated.
noEnergy.UK-13-881: White pepper: added as an Estimate food (id white-pepper), protein/fat/fibre from CoFID, carbohydrate estimated.
noEnergy.UK-13-879: Paprika: added as an Estimate food (id paprika), protein/fat/fibre from CoFID, carbohydrate estimated.
noEnergy.UK-13-878: Oregano: added as an Estimate food (id oregano-dried), protein/fat/fibre from CoFID, carbohydrate estimated.
